Arcline Fabrications NV, an Antwerp-based Steel Fabrication firm, is showing acute liquidity stress. Against client CL05 it carries 6 open invoices totalling EUR 559,900, the worst of them INV000075 at 45 days past due for EUR 145,600, sitting at about 68% of an EUR 820k credit limit that was last reviewed in Oct 2024. There is no settled invoice history, so the internal ledger is flagged "insufficient_history" and offers no payment trend. External reporting fills that gap and runs in one direction: three vendors described delays of 60 to 100 days against 45-day terms while the company kept placing fresh orders (NWS0004), at least two lenders opened a review of working capital exposure after a cash credit limit enhancement was not sanctioned in full (NWS0006), and in March 2026 workers at the Antwerp plant stopped work over part-paid wages and provident fund deductions made without remittance (NWS0007).

The score is 63.3, band High Risk, with PD 0.5831. The trace is 0.65 x 70.0 (payment, 45 DPD) + 0.35 x 50.9 (news) = 63.3, giving a payment contribution of 45.5 and a news contribution of 17.8. Only NWS0007 scores on the news leg, at severity 5 and decayed to 50.9 from age 204 days. The adjudicator agreed with caveats and called the band conservative, because three further severity-4 events — NWS0004 at 319 days, NWS0005 at 314 days and NWS0006 at 301 days — contribute nothing to the score yet escalate coherently into the wage arrears of March 2026 and then the August 2026 delinquency. Two caveats bear on how much weight the file can take: NWS0005 names "Arcline Inds." with no Antwerp location and matches the insured only on sector, so it should not be relied on until the legal entity is confirmed; and all news evidence predates the current delinquency, with no later reporting on whether the wage arrears were resolved.

The recommendation for Nordhaven Trade Credit (CL05) under LIM0002 is REDUCE: cut the current limit of EUR 820,000 to EUR 559,900, which caps the line at the amount already owed and eliminates undrawn headroom. The cut is sized to bring expected loss into the 25% appetite, taking it from EUR 365,779 to EUR 249,755 against a PD target of 0.25; the maximum liability constraint does not bind. The buy-while-delaying pattern in NWS0004 makes the headroom the live risk, since exposure could grow ahead of the next review, and the stale Oct 2024 limit should be re-underwritten before any further drawdown.

Lifting this band requires evidence the formula can see. The decisive item is the payment leg, which carries 45.5 of the 63.3: clearing INV000075 and building a run of settled invoices would replace the "insufficient_history" flag with a real trend and pull the 45 DPD input down. On the news side, the scoring item is already 204 days old and will keep decaying, but a refresh is needed rather than assumed — confirmation that the wage and provident fund arrears were settled, that the lender reviews closed without adverse classification, and that the vendor legal notices were discharged.
